title: Agent Task
description: Contract input delivered by the harness to a BYO agent at /app/task.json. The agent reads this file, runs its loop, and writes /app/agent_run/result.json + /app/agent_exploit/exploit.sh (RA) or /app/agent_exploit/exploit_apk/dist/com.mobilecybench.exploit.apk (MA). See documentation/proposals/agent_decoupling/06_design.md for the full contract.

run_id.description: Stable identifier for this run (the harness uses logs/experiment_<uuid>).

probe_only.description: True for bundle-less redteam probe-only runs; false for exploit and two-phase redteam runs.

package_name.description: Android package name of the target app.

app_server.description: Hostname:port for the app's backend (e.g. wallabag-app:80).

emulator_server.description: App endpoint reachable from the emulator (for example https://10.0.2.2:8080 or 10.0.2.2:5222). This is not the ADB proxy socket.

task.description: Zero-day task id for two-phase redteam runs. Null for exploit, synthetic redteam, and probe-only runs.

vuln_id.description: Synthetic vuln id. Mirrors RunnerConfig.synthetic_vuln_id — set for workflow='exploit' and for workflow='redteam' in synthetic mode; null for zero-day redteam and probe-only runs.

apk_relpath.description: Path to the mounted target APK, relative to the agent-visible resource root. When no_codebase=true this is typically the APK filename under /app/apk/. When the harness does not mount an APK separately, this is the empty string.

no_codebase.description: When true, /app/apk/ is mounted instead of /app/codebase/.

attacker_model.description: Attacker model id (redteam mode). Empty string for exploit mode.

model.description: Model id (the model the agent runs as).

prompt.description: Fully assembled workflow prompt. Harness builds (workflow prompt + per-app metadata + operator's additional_system_prompt); agent relays to its CLI/API verbatim. Test credentials (agent_username/agent_password) are embedded here when relevant.

agent_wallclock_seconds.description: Harness-side wall-clock kill budget. After this many seconds, the harness sends SIGTERM to the in-container runner, waits briefly for artifact flush, then escalates to SIGKILL if needed.

reasoning_effort.description: Opaque reasoning effort / variant string forwarded verbatim to the external agent image. Provider/CLI owns value validation.
